note: Stations A (ADF + Lakeflow Jobs) and B (ADLS) of the Lakehouse Lab. Every figure is a fictional teaching constant for the semiconductor scenario, never a measurement or a price.

external_feed.label: The on-prem feed landing starts the pipeline
external_feed.why: Azure Data Factory owns triggers from outside Databricks: a file landing, a schedule or a tumbling window. Lakeflow Jobs can't listen to the on-prem feed.

job_dependency.label: The silver job runs after the bronze job finishes
job_dependency.why: Lakeflow Jobs owns dependencies between jobs inside Databricks, with task-level retry and repair. Having ADF poll for it adds a second scheduler and a polling delay.

object_count.label: Teaching constant: how many folders and files one day of landed data is spread over in each layout. Not a measurement.

volume_gb.label: Teaching constant: the size of the bronze zone in gigabytes.

retention_days.label: Teaching constant: how many days of bronze data are kept.

storage_rate.label: Illustrative storage cost per gigabyte for each tier, relative to hot; check the current rate card. Never a quoted price.

access_rate.label: Illustrative read cost for each tier, relative to hot; check the current rate card. Never a quoted price.

read_share_by_age.label: Teaching constant: the share of reads that land on data of each age. Recent data is read most.

cost_weights.label: Teaching constant: how much of the combined cost index comes from storage and how much from reads. Not a measurement.
